svg.title: Mingyun Chae — Founder of TriAstra
svg.desc: Founder of TriAstra. Senior Backend & AI Agent Platform Engineer. 776 TriAstra PRs merged in the last 7 days, counted October 18, 2026 at 09:52 UTC using merges since October 11 at 10:00 UTC, all authors including bots. Approximately 10 AI agent role sessions and 100+ peak concurrent OMP coding agents; excludes Aside. Seven open-source fixes merged upstream, four hackathon first places, and US and Korean patent registrations. Snapshot: October 18, 2026; agent figures approximate from OMP logs.
